title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 11 · Ruined tower

sourceRecords.title: Area 11 · Concealed north entrance
read: A fallen tower lies under dusty canvas and brush. A few old crates remain where a storeroom once stood.

The canvas and vegetation break up the outline of what the tower used to be. The crates are the clearest remaining sign of its practical use. You can examine a visible patch of ground, check beneath accessible cover, or keep the ruined approach in sight while someone searches.

brief: Almost completely collapsed castle tower, open ground floor amid rubble, rotten crates and old barrels, heavy SOUTH curtain, intact wooden EAST door. North canvas-covered access not highlighted or revealed from exterior. No inhabitants, new supplies or hidden secret tunnel label. Natural daylight through ruin.
